verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Munito AI uses OpenAI- and Anthropic-compatible APIs and claims zero data retention. Both ease switching providers, but neither is a documented capability to export account data (usage, logs, settings) in open formats. Data export is a fair question for an inference platform with a console, so the axis applies, and the pack documents no export feature.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
